text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
While you have a Tamer, you may ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gains ＜S Attack -1＞ for the turn.
[Main] Place this card as the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your non-white Digimon.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [All Turns] When this Digimon would be deleted by battle, by placing 1 [Reload Plug-In Q] from its digivolution cards at the bottom of the security stack, prevent that deletion.
